title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Banana Nice Cream
intro: This frozen treat delivers the thick texture of soft-serve ice cream using simple everyday staples. It satisfies sweet cravings naturally with whole fruit, rich cocoa, and a steady supply of protein.

ingredients.name: Unsweetened almond milk
ingredients.canonical_name: Beverages, almond milk, unsweetened, shelf stable

ingredients.name: Natural creamy peanut butter
ingredients.canonical_name: Peanut butter, smooth, vitamin and mineral fortified

instructions: Place the frozen banana slices, Greek yogurt, almond milk, peanut butter, cocoa powder, and vanilla extract into a food processor or blender.
Pulse the ingredients to break down the frozen fruit, then blend on high speed.
Stop the machine and scrape down the sides with a rubber spatula to integrate the ingredients.
Blend until the mixture is smooth, thick, and resembles soft-serve ice cream.
Divide the mixture evenly between two serving bowls.
Sprinkle the dark chocolate chips over the top of each bowl.
variation: Swap the peanut butter for natural almond butter.
conservation: Best enjoyed right away; does not keep.
validation_warnings: Stage 4 coverage: 'Nonfat plain Greek yogurt': [330137] Yogurt, Greek, plain, nonfat has no USDA value for fiber_g (which would be summed as zero) — switched to [2705424] Yogurt, Greek, nonfat milk, plain.
